text: Nde jiwɓe ɓen hootunoo, ɓe humpiti ɗum baaba maɓɓe. O nuli kisan gooto e maɓɓe, yo noddoy mo. Jiwo on ari mum, no yahra hersa, o wi'i: Baaba am no nodde, fii yoɓugol ma njoɓdi ko yarnan-ɗaa men kon. Nde Muusaa hewtunoo ka mawɗo on, o humpiti mo fii makko, mawɗo on wallintini ɓernde makko, o wi'ani mo: wata a hulu, sabu a daɗii bone Fir'awna e yimɓe mun tooñooɓe, tawde alaa ko ɓe waawani Madyana; ɓe hewtataa ma fes.
